subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Bo's Learning Club 2 – Lesson 1: Science – Health
outcomes: Name common illnesses: a cold, a headache, a sore throat, a stomachache, a cough.
Give health advice with should and shouldn't.
Say what you do to stay healthy.

tf.s: With a stomachache, you should drink lots of water.
With a stomachache, you should eat a lot.
With a sore throat, you shouldn't shout.
A child should take medicine from his parents or a doctor.
tf.why: Well done! An adult gives medicine.

tf.s: With a headache, you should play video games.
tf.why: You shouldn't play video games with a headache.

tf.s: 'Should' means it is a good idea.
'Shouldn't' means it is a good idea.
Eating fruit and vegetables helps you stay healthy.
A cough and a sore throat can be a cold.
With a cold, you should go to school.
tf.why: You should rest in bed. You shouldn't go to school.

boxes.why: Rest in bed when you are ill.

boxes.q: He has a headache. He ___ play video games.
boxes.why: Video games are a bad idea with a headache.

boxes.q: Who should give medicine to a child?
Sami has a cough and a sore throat. What's the illness?

mcq.why: A sore throat is an illness.

mcq.q: What should you do with a stomachache?
o: drink lots of water and not eat a lot
mcq.why: Drink water and don't eat a lot.

o: They play sports and eat fruit and vegetables.
mcq.why: Sport and healthy food keep you well.

mcq.q: Ali has a headache. Which advice is right?
mcq.why: Rest is better than video games with a headache.

mcq.q: Give advice: He has a cold.
o: He should rest in bed. He shouldn't go to school.
He should go to school. He shouldn't rest.
He should shout. He shouldn't drink water.

mcq.q: The girl has a sore throat. What shouldn't she do?
Why should parents or a doctor give medicine to a child?
o: Medicine can be dangerous without an adult.
mcq.why: Adults know how much medicine to give.

mcq.q: Sami has a cough and a sore throat. What's the matter?
mcq.why: A cough and a sore throat can be a cold.

mcq.q: Which sentence gives a bad idea for a stomachache?
o: You should drink lots of water.
mcq.why: Eating a lot is a bad idea.
